# LoadRunner Java Vuser Import Coverage

<!-- Generated by `go generate ./pkg/convert/enterprisearchive` (cmd/webcoverage -set java-surfaces). Do not edit by hand. -->

This matrix covers the Java Vuser importer surfaces outside the closed `lrapi.lr` utility API. Every Java archive remains one `java_vuser` draft so init/action/end source ordering and per-VUser Java state are preserved. Static idiom analysis supplies review evidence only; launch requires approval plus an enabled governed JVM runner advertising `java_vuser_persistent_lifecycle_v1` and `java_vuser_session_frame_token_v1`.

## Surface Disposition

| ID | Area | Construct | Status | Execution | Review | Fields | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `java-lr-api` | LoadRunner Utility API | lrapi.lr.* | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes | transaction, parameter, message, runtime, timer | The closed lr API is classified for review and transaction evidence; its source remains in the combined governed Java Vuser draft. |
| `java-vm-runtime-settings` | Java VM | default.cfg [JavaVM:Options] | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes | config.java_vuser.jdk_selection, config.java_vuser.jdk_home, config.java_vuser.additional_vm_parameters, config.java_vuser.classpath, config.java_vuser.use_xbootclasspath, config.java_vuser.dedicated_class_loader | JDK, exact JVM argument, precompiled classpath, Xboot compatibility, and dedicated-loader settings are imported with per-setting parity status and validated by the governed runner before execution. |
| `java-web-http` | HTTP | web.* / HttpURLConnection / HttpClient / Apache HttpClient | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes | url, method, headers, body, transactions | HTTP evidence is reported for review, but Java source remains in one java_vuser draft so fields and phase ordering are preserved. |
| `java-jms` | Messaging | javax.jms / jakarta.jms | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes | provider, destination, body, properties, transactions | JMS evidence is reported for review; calls remain in the same source-order-preserving Java Vuser draft as every other Java protocol family. |
| `java-jdbc` | Database | java.sql DriverManager/Connection/PreparedStatement | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes | sql, query, exec, commit, rollback | JDBC evidence is reported for review; statements are not extracted into a separate database script. |
| `java-soap` | SOAP | JAX-WS / SOAPMessage / Axis / CXF | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes | endpoint, envelope | SOAP evidence is reported for review; clients remain part of the combined Java Vuser runner draft. |
| `java-no-runtime-surfaces` | Review | RMI, EJB, CORBA, SAP GUI Java, Jacada, Oracle NCA, Tuxedo | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes |  | Middleware calls are preserved in the combined source and require the governed runner classpath to supply their dependencies. |
| `java-custom-code` | Custom Java | helpers, third-party clients, arbitrary Java | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes |  | Arbitrary Java is preserved in one review draft; launch requires authoring approval and an enabled governed runner. |

| `java-jms-config` | JMS | JNDI env.put / InitialContext | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes | broker_url, provider, vpn, credentials | JNDI setup remains in init on the same persistent per-VUser Actions instance used by action and end. |

| `java-jms-message` | JMS | createTextMessage / readFile / replaceAll(lr.eval_string) | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes | body, template | Message construction remains in the combined draft and can use Java fields and saved LoadRunner parameters retained by the persistent per-VUser session. |
| `java-jms-publish-consume` | JMS | producer.send / consumer.receive | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes | publish, consume | Calls execute through the governed Java runner, not native JMS actions. |
| `java-jms-transaction` | JMS | commit / rollback / acknowledge | `supported` | `external_runner_required` | yes | commit, rollback, acknowledge | Session ownership and ordering remain in source and persist on the same per-VUser Actions instance across lifecycle calls. |
